claims.quote: Known only from the remote, mountainous area of Putao in Kachin state, northern Myanmar.

regions.name: Ayeyarwady
regions.quote: Both known localities, the Nan Hto Chaung and the Mali Hka River, are part of the upper Ayeyarwady system.

regions.name: Nan Hto Chaung
regions.quote: The holotype and most of the type series was collected from the Nan Hto Chaung (Nan Hto stream) with the Mali Hka River representing the only other locality known.
